verdict.rationale:
Otter documents scheduling its AI Notetaker to automatically join recurring Zoom/Teams/Meet meetings (otter-docs-17), which is a form of recurring automated job, but there's no evidence of broader recurring workflow scheduling (e.g., automated recurring reports, digests, or triggerable jobs beyond meeting attendance).

missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose recurring workflow/job scheduling (e.g., scheduled digests, automated recurring reports, cron-like triggers) beyond auto-joining meetings, and any independent confirmation of this scheduling feature working reliably.
